body.name: empirical, exact fitted-center, and diffusion-center Wald intervals
body.construction:
Set
\[
 I_{\mathrm{emp}}=[\widehat\theta_N\pm z_\alpha\sqrt{\widehat V/(NT_N)}],
 \qquad
 I_{\mathrm{fit}}=[\widetilde\theta_N\pm z_\alpha\sqrt{\widehat Q/(NT_N)}],
 \qquad
 I_{\mathrm{diff}}=[\overline\theta_N\pm z_\alpha\sqrt{\widehat Q/(NT_N)}],
\]
where \(\widehat V\) and \(\widehat Q\) plug \((\widehat p,\widehat\gamma_N)\) into \(V\) and \(Q\), respectively.  Here \(I_{\mathrm{fit}}\) is centered at the exact finite-chain product-law plug-in effect, whereas \(I_{\mathrm{diff}}\) is reserved for the diffusion approximation.
